title: Length of the combined embedded gates
statement: For any finite list $D_1,\ldots,D_r$ of directed acyclic circuits with $m$ input vertices, any list $srcs$ of natural numbers, and any natural number $L$, the number of gates in the list formed by embedding these circuits successively equals the sum of their widths, where the width of each circuit is its number of gates plus one.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ specifying the common input count
A finite list of directed acyclic circuits with $m$ input vertices
